description: Validates that recently-built enrichment modules (temporal_stability_enrichment, permission_scope_enrichment, tool_description_safety_enrichment) are wired into the signal_analyser pipeline and producing outputs with >20 distinct scores across 34 fingerprints. Reads: temporal_stability_enrichment.py, permission_scope_enrichment.py, tool_description_safety_enrichment.py, signal_analyser.py. Runs compute_score() against synthetic corpus, asserts discrimination. Pure library, no DB writes.
